title: DepthMSA: Combinatorial Training and Budget-Aware Depth Allocation for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2611.27198v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: State-of-the-art multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) models rely on large pretrained encoders, yet typically process every modality to its full depth, regardless of its computational cost or predictive contribution. This raises a fundamental question: how should limited computation be allocated across modalities to preserve predictive performance? We reveal a substantial mismatch between the computational cost of modality encoders and the predictive benefit of processing them more deeply, suggesting that different modalities require different encoding depths. However, enabling heterogeneous depths introduces a key challenge: representations extracted at different depths must still be effectively fused. To address this, we propose $\textbf{DepthMSA}$, a budget-aware framework that supports flexible modality depths within a single MSA model. translated_title: DepthMSA：面向多模态情感分析的组合式训练与预算感知深度分配
translated_abstract: 最先进的多模态情感分析（MSA）模型依赖于大型预训练编码器，但通常将每种模态都处理到其全部深度，而不考虑其计算成本或预测贡献。这引出了一个根本性问题：应如何在各模态之间分配有限的计算资源以保持预测性能？我们揭示了模态编码器的计算成本与对其进行更深处理所带来的预测收益之间存在显著的不匹配，这表明不同模态需要不同的编码深度。然而，启用异构深度带来了一个关键挑战：从不同深度提取的表示仍然必须能够被有效融合。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 DepthMSA，一个预算感知的框架，可在单个 MSA 模型中支持灵活的模态深度。具体而言，我们引入了组合式随时训练（combinatorial anytime training），它对融合头进行监督（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出 DepthMSA 框架，通过组合式随时训练与预算感知的深度分配，在单个多模态情感分析模型中为不同模态灵活分配异构编码深度，从而在有限计算预算下保持预测性能。
en_tdlr: DepthMSA is a budget-aware framework that enables flexible, heterogeneous encoding depths across modalities via combinatorial anytime training, preserving predictive performance in multimodal sentiment analysis under limited computational budgets.
